text:
Priya: morning — quick sync re: Acme SI + NimbusHW joint announcement and marketplace private-offer renewal sequencing. need to avoid overlapping commit windows.
Mason: +1. what target week are we aligning to?
Priya: target launch week is 2025-06-16. link to draft timeline: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/launch-acme-nimbus (internal)
Ellen: SI asked if we can shift renewal window by 1 week on their end — they have an internal fiscal close the week of 6/16 :thinking:
Samir: HW partner has shipment window constraints — their pricing team wants the private-offer to land before shipments out (so they can advertise bundle discounts). risk if we move too late.
Priya: proposal: phased windows so we don't create multiple large billing spikes. rough plan:
  - phase A (hw early-bird): 2025-06-02 to 2025-06-08 (partner promo)
  - phase B (si onboarding window): 2025-06-16 to 2025-06-22 (SI cohort + credits)
  - phase C (mp commit burst): 2025-06-30 to 2025-07-06 (marketplace reserved capacity commit conversion)
Mason: can sales ops support split billing and staggered invoice dates? cc @Samir
Samir: yes, but we need clear commit buckets and Sku mapping up front. i'll need tiered commit buckets from partnerships + finance.
Ellen: SI is ok with phase B as long as onboarding credits extend 30 days post-sign. they also want co-branded docs before announce.
Priya: copying a minimal SKU map for ops:
```
# SKU mapping for bundles
HW-XL -> private-offer-HW-30pct
SI-ONB-50 -> onboarding-credit-50k
STACK-COMB -> HW+SI-bundle-20pct
```
Mason: ok. Sales ops action: implement split invoicing templates, map SKUs to billing codes. i'll draft PR. :memo:
Samir: sample commit buckets i'm thinking: [50k, 150k, 500k] USD monthly equivalents. higher tiers get longer credit windows.
Priya: agree. owners: Mason = field comms & billing templates; Ellen = SI collateral + co-brand docs; Samir = ops & commit buckets; Priya = partner lead + announcement timing.
Ellen: i'll ping SI lead (leila@acme) now to confirm phase B dates.
Launch-Bot: calendar event created "Acme/Nimbus Announcement Orbit" on 2025-06-10 10:00 PT — https://calendar.redwood.com/event/abc123
Priya: please confirm owners by EOD. if no blockers we lock timeline end of day tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Mason: confirmed.
Ellen: confirmed with SI (Leila) — they need co-brand logos by 6/4.
Samir: drafting the renewal clause language for private offers and sending to finance for sign-off. expect PR by 6/1.
Priya: great — i'll assemble a 1-pager announcement runbook with milestones and pre-approve playbook snippets. will post in this thread when ready.
Mason: thanks all.
Ellen: thanks :rocket:
